mara.activity: Wake, wash, brush my teeth, and change into workout clothes.
mara.intention: Start slowly but keep enough structure in the morning for the workout and presentation day.

mara.activity: Do my short strength workout and shower.
mara.intention: Clear some mental pressure before making judgments about the presentation.

mara.activity: Dress for work, make coffee, and eat a quick breakfast at the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Fuel the morning without letting breakfast expand into a long pause.

mara.activity: Carry my work things to the entryway, place my keys deliberately there while I put on my shoes, and leave for the studio.
mara.intention: Leave with the presentation materials and avoid beginning the day by searching for anything.

mara.activity: Work at the studio on the major presentation and planting-plan revisions, checking the narrative, drawings, and priorities in sequence.
mara.intention: Make the core judgments clear and defensible while keeping the design beautiful rather than merely complete.

mara.activity: Attend a site visit and review planting conditions, light, circulation, and maintenance implications.
mara.intention: Test the plan against what the site is actually doing instead of solving everything abstractly at the desk.

mara.activity: Eat a simple lunch and make brief notes before the afternoon meetings.
mara.intention: Keep my attention steady through the afternoon without overworking the break.

mara.activity: Continue studio work and client coordination, refining the presentation details and preparing the materials that need to be defensible tomorrow.
mara.intention: Bring the plan into a coherent state, distinguishing essential revisions from tempting but unnecessary refinements.

mara.activity: Travel home, put my keys in the open entryway while removing my shoes, carry my field notebook to the living room sideboard countertop, and have a brief snack and water before the committee meeting.
mara.intention: Make a clean transition without losing the notes I will need later.

mara.activity: Gather my committee notes and leave for the community garden meeting.
mara.intention: Arrive prepared but not already arguing the whole meeting in my head.

mara.activity: Attend the community garden committee meeting and discuss maintenance priorities and the budget disagreements.
mara.intention: Keep the conversation practical, especially where maintenance needs and available funds do not align.

mara.activity: Return home, place my keys on the kitchen island, wash my hands, and make toast with scrambled eggs at the island.
mara.intention: Eat something warm and uncomplicated rather than carrying the meeting tension directly into more work.

mara.activity: Wash the plate, skillet, and mug, wipe the island, and leave the market herbs in their glass beside the sink.
mara.intention: Restore enough order that the kitchen does not add another demand to the evening.

mara.activity: Review only the final presentation checklist and make a short list of tomorrow's first decisions at the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Give the deadline a defined boundary instead of reopening the entire project.

mara.activity: Put the laptop and project materials away, change into sleep clothes, and wash up.
mara.intention: End the workday deliberately, even if a few details remain imperfect.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea and carry the mug to the bedroom.
mara.intention: Settle the remaining meeting and deadline pressure before bed.

mara.activity: Read quietly in bed, then place my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Let the day close with something sensory and unproductive.
Rest before the presentation work resumes.

julian.activity: Wake quietly, wash, brush my teeth, and get dressed while the house is calm. I make the bed before leaving the bedroom.
julian.intention: Start slowly and avoid waking Mara or creating unnecessary decisions.

julian.activity: Make coffee and a simple breakfast, carrying a mug and a plate to the kitchen island. I eat with Mara if she is home, keeping the conversation easy and not pressing her about work.
julian.intention: Give both of us a quiet, familiar start before the workday.

julian.activity: Clear the breakfast things, carry the mug and plate to the sink, rinse them, and pack fresh coffee into my thermos. I leave my restaurant notebook and receipts on the island while I check the day's prep priorities.
julian.intention: Set up the restaurant shift without turning the morning into a planning meeting.

julian.activity: Finish dressing for the restaurant, collect my backpack and chef jacket, and carry the knife roll from its lower kitchen-cabinet shelf. I check that my phone, wallet, and keys are with me before leaving.
julian.intention: Leave with the essential tools and avoid having to turn back.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, and kitchen management. I receive the delivery, check quantities and temperatures, sharpen the prep plan around anything missing, and keep the kitchen moving through inspection-preparation tasks.
julian.intention: Get the Wednesday kitchen in order and reduce the chance of another service surprise.

julian.activity: Travel home, put the thermos beside the kitchen sink, and change out of my restaurant clothes. I carry my wallet and earplugs to the living room coffee table, then keep the house quiet.
julian.intention: Mark the end of the first shift and make a clean break before resting.

julian.activity: Take a short nap and reset in the main bedroom, with no television and no phone scrolling.
julian.intention: Recover enough to handle dinner service safely and patiently.

julian.activity: Wake, drink water, wash my face, and eat a small snack from the refrigerator. I rinse the bowl and fork and leave them by the sink rather than starting a full cleanup.
julian.intention: Refuel without spending the reset period on cooking or decisions.

julian.activity: Collect my backpack, knife roll, phone, and keys, then leave for the evening shift.
julian.intention: Return to work on time with my attention narrowed to the next service.

julian.activity: Run dinner service and closing duties. I lead the line through the rush, finish the Wednesday preparation list, close down the stations, and carry the thermos home with me.
julian.intention: Protect the quality of service while getting the kitchen safely shut down.

julian.activity: Return home, put the thermos beside the kitchen sink, and drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table. I take a hot shower and leave the day there.
julian.intention: Come down from service without turning on the television or starting another task.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion from the refrigerator at the kitchen island, carrying a bowl and fork there. I rinse them and set them beside the sink when I am done.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach with something familiar and keep cleanup minimal.

julian.activity: Brush my teeth, carry my phone charger to the nightstand, change into sleep clothes, and get into bed with Mara.
julian.intention: Finish the night without extra stimulation and protect tomorrow's sleep.
